name: Vector Phase Projection
description: Replaces the modular arithmetic drift formula with a geometric dot-product formulation. The three frequency bands are mapped to 120-degree separated unit vectors in 2D space. The dot product of any distinct pair is exactly -0.5, while identical vectors yield 1. Scaled and shifted, this produces the exact same 0/1 drift values as the original formula, but models that rely on recognizing modular arithmetic patterns for 3-coloring will fail to make the geometric connection.
